_provenance.note: Transcribed verbatim; the spec wraps long base64url strings across lines for typesetting and the wrapping is undone here (the same treatment as tests/fixtures/interop/rfc9901-a3-sd-jwt-vc.txt). Unlike the Section 8.2 fragments this one is a complete, genuinely signed ES256 compact JWS over the embedded `jwk`; F.1's second block is the same token's decoded header and payload.
